subject: Malaysia M-510: Mathys wall-paint TDS and sample
body:
For Mathys' water-based wall-paint assessment, M-510 is a chloride-process rutile grade. Its TDS lists interior/exterior wall latex paints and typical TiO2 content of 95%.

Our REACH registration certificate is available for review.

I've attached the M-510 TDS and REACH information for your review.

We can provide a free 1 kg sample.

Shall we arrange a sample for your technical team's evaluation?
